Author intent, source conditions and bot execution

The reader fixes from PR #11 are deployed at 9bc00db. This follow-up connects each retained script to its source contract and author-review status. It does not approve a scanner for trading, establish profitability, or replace an existing reader.

Coverage is not completion. Prior line-by-line source work was reused after hash checks; five newer source versions were reconciled separately. Full author-description review is complete for the previously studied Willy and BigBeluga catalogues, plus ten further publications. For the whole retained library, 248 of 2626 author publications are reconciled. Downloaded descriptions are labelled pending; unavailable pages are not treated as reviewed.

Confirmed integration gaps

  • RSI Volume Ladder: the author adds up to three legs and recalculates basket brackets. The bot ignores same-direction adds. A native basket adapter must keep the aggregate $150 budget and risk limits; the current strategy is an adaptation.
  • Absorption Reversal: the source spacing OR can bypass absorption. Lower-timeframe candle delta coverage is also unresolved. Its existing quarantine stays in place.
  • Trend FVG Delta: the author describes discretionary rejection entries; the source draws zones and statistics, not a complete entry condition. Candle-position volume is a proxy.
  • ML RSI classifier and SuperTrend cluster consensus outputs must remain distinct from regime/member flips. The existing comparison variants supply that distinction; generic-reader history is not interchangeable.
  • Trend Impulse continuation, Kinetic's selected marker, Asia-only Killzones and Pivot's long-only reading are deliberate bot variants. Compare alternatives under separate identities.

What changes in the bot

Library → select a script → Author intent and bot reading shows the publication author, reviewed source date, entry conditions, non-entry markers, stop/target/exit logic, timing caveats and current reading. A changed source hides obsolete conditions. Historical claims are scoped to the scanner and labelled as historical; refuted and unchecked claims are excluded. No scan, admission, position, risk or evidence setting changes.

Remaining work

Review pending author explanations by family, reconcile every meaningful update against the pinned source, then reproduce each actionable mismatch with real source outputs. New lifecycle adapters need causal fill tests and separate shadow evidence. Preserve context-only roles; do not force every publication to generate entries.
